idea-plugin.name: Free Colorflow Brackets
idea-plugin.description:
Free Colorflow Brackets

A completely free alternative to subscription or fee based alternatives - Colors nested curly braces {} based on nesting depth across all supported programming languages.

  • Universal Support: Works with C#, Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, and all supported languages
  • 6 Color Levels: Handles deeply nested code structures
  • Customizable: Set your own colors in Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → Free Bracket Colorer
  • 100% Free: No subscriptions, no limitations, completely open source
  • Lightweight: Minimal performance impact
